props.title: Frequently Asked Questions - Help Center
props.description: Find answers about booking poojas online, payment, cancellation, prasadam dispatch, and support on MyPoojaBooking.

booking.question: What is MyPoojaBooking?
booking.answer: MyPoojaBooking is a technology platform that enables devotees to book sevas online at participating temples and make payments securely. The platform facilitates seamless coordination between devotees and temples for seva bookings.

booking.question: How do I know my seva booking is confirmed?
booking.answer: Once the booking and payment are successfully completed, a confirmation receipt is generated. The receipt contains booking details, seva information, and the temple’s contact details.

booking.question: Can I cancel or reschedule a seva?
booking.answer: Cancellation or rescheduling of sevas is subject to the respective temple’s policies and the nature of the seva. Devotees are requested to refer to the cancellation terms displayed at the time of booking.

payments.question: What support does MyPoojaBooking provide?
payments.answer: MyPoojaBooking support assists devotees with booking-related queries, payment confirmations, and technical issues on the platform. For seva or Prasadam-related matters, support may assist by coordinating with the temple if required.

payments.question: How can I contact MyPoojaBooking support?
payments.answer: Support contact details are available on the website under the Contact Us section. Devotees may reach out for any platform-related assistance. We request devotees’ understanding, as temple rituals and associated processes are governed by individual temple practices.

seva.question: Who conducts the seva and related rituals?
seva.answer: All sevas and rituals are conducted by the respective temple in accordance with its traditions and practices. MyPoojaBooking does not perform or influence the conduct of religious rituals.

prasadam.question: How is Prasadam handled?
prasadam.answer: Prasadam, where applicable, is prepared and dispatched by the respective temple. The preparation, packaging, and dispatch are managed by the temple as per its internal processes.

prasadam.question: I have not received Prasadam. Whom should I contact?
prasadam.answer: For any queries related to Prasadam dispatch or delivery, devotees are requested to contact the temple directly. The temple’s contact mobile number is mentioned on the seva receipt / booking confirmation.

prasadam.question: Does MyPoojaBooking handle courier or delivery?
prasadam.answer: No. Courier arrangements, delivery logistics, and tracking details are managed by the temple administration. MyPoojaBooking does not control courier services.

helpCard.title: Need more help?
helpCard.description: Our support team is available to assist you with platform-related queries.
